products.name: Restaurant POS Software
products.shortDescription: High-speed touch billing, interactive table layouts, kitchen display orders, and seamless thermal receipt printing.
products.fullDescription: AADI Restaurant POS is engineered specifically for cafes, fine dining, quick-service eateries, and multi-branch food chains. It streamlines table turns, connects front-of-house waitstaff directly to the kitchen, and gives managers real-time visibility over inventory, recipe consumption, and daily net revenue.
features: Comprehensive daily sales and cashier shift reports
ESC/POS Thermal printer support with auto-cutter
benefits: Reduces order preparation mistakes with instant digital kitchen printing
Accelerates peak dining hour checkout times to under 15 seconds
Stops food wastage with ingredient-level depletion alerts
Works offline with instant local database synchronization

systemRequirements.os: Windows 10 / 11, Android 9.0+, or Modern Web Browser
systemRequirements.processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or higher
systemRequirements.ram: 4 GB RAM minimum (8 GB recommended for heavy loads)
systemRequirements.extras: Supports standard 80mm / 58mm thermal printers, cash drawers, and barcode scanners

faqs.question: Can this software run if our internet connection drops?
faqs.answer: Yes. AADI Restaurant POS features full offline resilience. Cashiers can continue placing table orders, printing KOTs, and generating guest receipts uninterrupted.

faqs.question: Does it support multiple kitchen stations and bar printers?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can route appetizer and drink items to specific printers or KOT displays automatically based on product categories.

faqs.question: Can we install it on Android touch tablets for waitstaff?
faqs.answer: Yes, waitstaff can take orders tableside using Android tablets or wireless handheld POS terminals.

products.pricingNote: Custom quote based on restaurant size, stations, and printer hardware.
